confidence_notes: Food anchors reflect recent Arusha price observations, though the available data are sparse and venues vary. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their local price relationship to domestic draft beer; accommodation estimates are holistic and sensitive to July safari-season demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: No substitute city used; food and drink estimates use Arusha-specific price observations, while accommodation reflects Arusha’s role as a northern Tanzania safari gateway.
